about.intro: I'm a Computer Science & Engineering student focused on AI Engineering, with a strong backend foundation in Java and Spring Boot. I'm building toward becoming an AI Engineer who can design, develop, and deploy practical AI-powered products, not just experiment with models.
about.body: Right now, I'm deepening my skills in AI engineering, LLMs, AI APIs, intelligent workflows, and backend system design while continuing to strengthen my DSA and software engineering fundamentals. I'm particularly interested in building production-oriented AI applications where strong backend architecture and AI capabilities work together to solve real problems.

projects.title: Solvix
projects.what: An AI-powered DSA practice tracker that automatically imports your Codeforces and LeetCode history, scores which topics have decayed, and generates a daily study plan with spaced-repetition reminders — no manual logging required.
projects.hardPart: Free-tier hosting sleeps when idle, so daily plans and reminders run on an external GitHub Actions cron instead of an in-process timer.

projects.title: Real-Time Drowsiness Detection
projects.what: A computer vision system that monitors a live webcam feed, tracks facial landmarks, and computes Eye Aspect Ratio in real time to detect fatigue — triggering an audio alert when eyes stay closed past a threshold.
projects.hardPart: Tuning the EAR threshold and frame count to catch real drowsiness without firing on ordinary blinks, while staying fast enough for live video.

projects.title: Secure Auth System
projects.what: A Spring Boot authentication system implementing user registration, login, and role-based access control (USER/ADMIN), with BCrypt password encryption and session-managed protected routes.
projects.hardPart: Designing role-based access, BCrypt storage, and session handling into the Spring Security layer from the start, rather than bolting security on afterwards.
